capabilities: Select a list line and all deeper-indented lines below it
Rearrange selections with the Move line up/down commands
Change outline level using Tab and Shift-Tab
disambiguation: Not an outliner plugin; it only adds a selection command for the current list subtree.
extras: The README mimics OneNote's Cmd+A twice behavior; it also contains only copyright information beyond the feature description.
intentEvidence: portions of project obsidian-list-outline-helper are held by Gokul K, 2023 as part of project select-current-line-plugin
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to select an entire list subtree (a line plus its indented children) in one action.

relations.evidence: Copyright for portions of project obsidian-list-outline-helper are held by Gokul K, 2023 as part of project select-current-line-plugin

summary: Command-based utility that selects the current list line together with all deeper-indented child lines of its outline.
